segments.title: Netflix now picks by your mood
segments.say: Netflix now helps you pick something to watch by your mood.

segments.title: A new 'Discover' button
segments.say: Look for a new Discover button at the top of the app.

segments.title: Pick a vibe
segments.say: Pick a vibe, like something light, scare me, or family movie night.

segments.title: Then tune it
segments.say: Use Tune Your Recommendations to save or hide titles.

segments.title: Who has it first
segments.say: It's rolling out in the US, in English, on supported TVs first.

segments.title: SAVE THIS
